title: Go live with the Babulus waitlist via Prospectus
description:
The code is merged (AnthusAI/Prospectus#48, Babulus #11). The form shows "The waitlist opens soon" until all of these are done:

1. Ryan approves the babulus-waitlist-v1 notice: owner, privacy wording (Babulus privacy/terms copy from #11), retention, abuse controls, and the meaning of marketing_opt_in (updates email).
2. In Prospectus, set the Babulus entry in intake-forms.json to enabled:true with the approval string, then deploy. Read the IntakeWaitlistBaseUrl output.
3. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_PROSPECTUS_INTAKE_BASE_URL in Babulus's Amplify hosting environment to that base URL.
4. Deploy babul.us (blocked on 84493f / 6abb0a), then submit one real test signup and confirm it lands in the Prospectus CRM with labels waitlist + app-babulus.

Open product question for Ryan: should waitlist leads ever get follow-up dates, or be reviewed in bulk by label?
